places.name: Burj Khalifa
places.ai_summary: The tallest building in the world, Burj Khalifa offers breathtaking views from its observation decks and luxurious dining options.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 45 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to skip the queue.
places.address: 1 Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd, Downtown Dubai, UAE

places.name: Dubai Mall
places.ai_summary: One of the largest malls in the world, Dubai Mall features shopping, dining, and entertainment, including an aquarium and ice rink.

opening_hours.notes: Extended hours during holidays.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the fountain show in the evening.
places.address: Financial Center Road, Downtown Dubai, UAE

places.name: Palm Jumeirah
places.ai_summary: An artificial archipelago, Palm Jumeirah is known for its palm-shaped layout, luxury hotels, and upscale restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the views.

places.place_tip: Take the monorail for a scenic view of the Palm.

attribution.title: Artificial Archipelagos, Dubai, United Arab Emirates ISS022-E-024940 lrg (cropped)
attribution.author: Member of the Expedition 22 crew.
attribution.description:
The municipality of Dubai is the largest city of the Persian Gulf emirate of the same name, and has built a global reputation for large-scale developments and architectural works. Among the most visible of these developments—particularly from the perspective of astronauts on board the International Space Station—are three human-made archipelagos. The two Palm Islands (Palm Jumeirah and Palm Jebel Ali) appear as stylized palm trees when viewed from above. The World Islands evoke a rough map of the world from an air- or space-borne perspective. Palm Jumeirah and the World Islands are highlighted in this astronaut photograph.

Palm Jumeirah (image lower left) was begun in 2001 and required more than 50 million cubic meters of dredged sand to raise the islands above the Persian Gulf sea level. Construction of the Palm Jumeirah islands was completed in 2006; the islands are now being developed for residential and commercial housing and infrastructure. Creation of the 300 World Islands (image upper right) was begun in 2003 and completed in 2008, using 320 million cubic meters of sand and 37 million tonnes of rock for the surrounding 27-kilometer-long protective breakwater. Little to no infrastructure development of The World is apparent in this astronaut photograph.

Also visible at the lower edge of the astronaut photograph is another notable structure—the Burj Khalifa (image lower right and rotated 90 degrees in inset). Burj Khalifa stands 800 meters (2,600 feet) high, and it is currently the world’s tallest structure. The astronaut photograph captures enough detail to make out the tapering outline of the building as well as its dark, needle-like shadow pointing towards the northeast.

places.name: Dubai Marina
places.ai_summary: A vibrant waterfront community, Dubai Marina is famous for its skyscrapers, luxury yachts, and lively nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the nightlife.

places.place_tip: Visit the Marina Walk for dining and shopping.

attribution.title: Dubai Marina Skyline
attribution.author: Norlando Pobre
attribution.description: The skyscrapers of Dubai Marina

places.name: Desert Safari
places.ai_summary: Experience the thrill of dune bashing, camel riding, and sandboarding in the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is essential.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothing and closed shoes.
places.address: Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, Dubai, UAE

places.name: Dubai Miracle Garden
places.ai_summary: A stunning garden featuring over 50 million flowers, Dubai Miracle Garden is a floral wonderland with themed gardens and structures.

opening_hours.notes: Seasonal attraction, check opening dates.

places.place_tip: Visit during the week to avoid crowds.

places.name: Jumeirah Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular public beach, Jumeirah Beach offers white sand, clear waters, and views of the Burj Al Arab.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring your own beach equipment and refreshments.

attribution.title: Beach @ Jumeirah Beach Residence @ Dubai Marina (15852332215)
attribution.author: Guilhem Vellut

places.name: Burj Al Arab
places.ai_summary: An iconic luxury hotel, Burj Al Arab is known for its distinctive sail-shaped silhouette and opulent interior.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking required for dining and tours.

places.place_tip: Enjoy afternoon tea at the hotel for a luxurious experience.
places.address: Jumeirah St, Umm Suqeim, Dubai, UAE

places.name: Dubai Frame
places.ai_summary: A futuristic structure, Dubai Frame offers a museum and an observation deck with panoramic views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum exhibits before heading to the observation deck.

places.name: Museum of the Future
places.ai_summary: An architectural marvel, the Museum of the Future showcases innovative and futuristic concepts and designs.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Tuesdays.

places.place_tip: Book the 'Future Heroes' experience for an interactive adventure.

places.name: Global Village
places.ai_summary: A seasonal cultural and entertainment destination, Global Village features pavilions from different countries, offering food, crafts, and performances.

opening_hours.notes: Open from late October to early April.

places.place_tip: Try the street food and visit the cultural shows.
places.address: Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE

places.name: Dubai Creek
places.ai_summary: A historic waterway, Dubai Creek offers a glimpse into the city's past with its traditional dhows and bustling souks.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored by taking an abra ride.

places.place_tip: Visit the Dubai Museum and Al Fahidi Historical District nearby.

attribution.title: The view of Dubai Creek
attribution.author: Phil6007
attribution.description: This image was taken in Dubai Creek!

places.name: Al Seef District
places.ai_summary: A charming waterfront promenade, Al Seef District blends the old and new Dubai with its shops, restaurants, and cultural spaces.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the cooler months.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for unique shops and galleries.

attribution.title: Dubai skyline 2015 (crop)
attribution.author: Tim.Reckmann
attribution.description: Skyline of Downtown Dubai with Burj Khalifa from a Helicopter (crop of File:Dubai skyline 2015.jpg)

places.name: Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
places.ai_summary: Located in Dubai Mall, this is one of the largest suspended aquariums in the world, home to thousands of aquatic animals.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the underwater tunnel for a 270-degree view of the aquarium.

places.name: Madinat Jumeirah Souk
places.ai_summary: A traditional Arabian market, the Souk Madinat Jumeirah offers a variety of goods, from spices to textiles, in a picturesque setting.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the ambiance.

places.place_tip: Bargain for souvenirs and try the local street food.

places.name: Gold & Spice Souks
places.ai_summary: Located in the heart of Dubai's old city, the Gold and Spice Souks are traditional markets offering a variety of spices, textiles, and gold jewelry.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Look for the Dubai Frame in the distance as a landmark.

attribution.title: Dubai Gold Souk on 31 May 2007 Pict 1
attribution.author: Imre Solt
attribution.description: This is a photo showing the Dubai Gold Souk in Deira, Dubai, United Arab Emirates on 31 May 2007.

places.name: Bluewaters Island
places.ai_summary: A modern island destination, Bluewaters Island is home to Ain Dubai, the world's largest observation wheel, and offers dining and entertainment options.

opening_hours.notes: Ain Dubai operates from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Take a ride on Ain Dubai for stunning views of the city.

attribution.title: The Ain Dubai
attribution.author: Roxy3115
attribution.description: Calm evening view of Ain Dubai with colorful lightings in entire Bluewaters area.

places.name: IMG Worlds of Adventure
places.ai_summary: The world's largest indoor theme park, IMG Worlds of Adventure offers a variety of rides and attractions based on popular cartoon and comic characters.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended on weekends.

places.place_tip: Check out the Marvel and Cartoon Network zones.
places.address: Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Rd, Dubai, UAE

places.name: Sky Views Glass Bridge
places.ai_summary: A thrilling glass bridge experience, Sky Views Glass Bridge is located in the Address Sky View hotel and offers stunning views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Sky Lounge for refreshments.
places.address: Address Sky View, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd, Dubai, UAE

places.name: Al Fahidi Historical District
places.ai_summary: A glimpse into Dubai's past, Al Fahidi Historical District features preserved heritage buildings and museums.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the cooler hours of the day.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the history and culture.

attribution.title: Al Bastakiya of Dubai
attribution.author: Phil6007
attribution.description: This image was taken in Dubai!

places.name: Dubai Opera
places.ai_summary: An architectural masterpiece, Dubai Opera is a multi-format theatre and concert hall located in the Downtown Dubai area.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for performance timings.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.
places.address: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd, Dubai, UAE

places.name: The View at The Palm
places.ai_summary: An observation deck at the Palm Tower, The View at The Palm offers 360-degree views of Palm Jumeirah, the Arabian Gulf, and Dubai's skyline.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the observation deck during sunset for stunning views.
places.address: The Palm Tower, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai, UAE
